answer: Each identity plants an ember in the garden: a 60-credit bond on the nebula bounty board. Any hunter may file a fraud proof on a suspect, staking 20; a proven duplicate burns its ember, paying the hunter 40; a false claim burns the hunter's 20, killing false-claim spam. Each fake needs a fresh root: first 60, kth 60+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,057,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once; anyone can re-verify each proof on the nebula log.
